details:
I'm using an old Oculus Rift cv1 from 2017 and I'm running VRChat via the Oculus app (NOT SteamVR).
Ever since the start of the beta, I've noticed that when playing in VR, the game appears "laggy" or "choppy" even though I'm at a solid 90 fps. Rotating my head around has no visible issues, but when looking at my hand and moving it left to right, I notice it has a sort of "afterimage" that trails behind it. And its not just my hand for that matter, anything that moves, or the environment when I'm moving around myself, is choppy. The best way to describe it is it looks exactly like when you're lagging and your fps is low in vrchat, even though I'm not lagging at all. This issue does not happen in other vr apps, nor does it happen on the live build, and it also isn't visible while playing in desktop mode.
In fact, when playing in desktop mode, I've noticed my fps counter is at 60 instead of 90 (This is perfectly fine as the refresh rate of my monitor is 60hz), But I'm assuming something as been done in the backend of vrchat to match the fps to the refresh rate. So I'm taking a wild guess that the issue I'm experiencing while in VR is related to refresh rate/fps in some way.
The problem also seems to be unrelated to worlds/avatars or user created content, as it happens even during the loading screen when loading into the game. Any attempts to record the issue have failed because, as one might expect, refresh rate isn't something that can be recorded on video. (I've tried, the problem just isn't visible when looking at a recording of it).
Hardware specs:
CPU i7-6700
GPU gtx 1070
16gb of ram
Headset Oculus Rift CV1
title: [1188] Incorrect display refresh rate/FPS problem
